reden: Not detected. The described issue is a forced endTime extension in PhiFactory.updateArtSettings() (requirement that endTime_ >= block.timestamp) which reopens minting and enables a backrun merkleClaim to mint additional supply. The audit report does not analyze updateArtSettings’ time checks or the reopening of the mint window. Mentions of updateArtSettings in the report are only incidental (as a control an attacker gains via createArt hijack), not about the endTime logic. None of the reported findings cover this mechanism or code path, and fixing the described endTime/validation issue would not address any of the report’s findings.
